topic: Faster attention kernels: Yandex FLAMIA on Nvidia Blackwell
brief: Full 2-minute explainer: build the diagram step by step, show the before/after and end with the takeaway. News hook (Nov 2026, per AI Weekly): Yandex open-sourced FLAMIA, attention kernels for Nvidia Blackwell GPUs that reportedly speed up the training backward pass about 2x with little impact on loss. Explain why attention needs custom kernels: memory traffic between HBM and on-chip SRAM is the bottleneck, so tiling and fusing operations (the FlashAttention idea) keep data on-chip. Keep claims about FLAMIA to these facts only.
